name: Fourthwall
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Receives Fourthwall webhooks and fires triggers when someone donates, orders merch, buys gifts for your community, or joins a membership.

settings.label: Fourthwall webhook secret
settings.description: Found in Fourthwall under Settings, For developers. Requests not signed with it are refused.

triggers.name: Fourthwall webhook
triggers.description: Paste this URL into Fourthwall's webhook settings. Every request is checked against your webhook secret before anything fires.

triggers.name: Fourthwall donation
triggers.description: Fires when someone donates through your Fourthwall shop.

fields.description: Fourthwall's id for this event. A retried delivery carries the same id.
Who paid, as they chose to show it. Empty when they gave none.
The buyer's message. Empty when they left none.
In the currency's main unit: 10 is 10.00.
The amount with two decimals and no currency symbol.
ISO 4217 code.
True when Fourthwall marks the event as test data.

triggers.name: Fourthwall order placed
triggers.description: Fires when someone buys merch from your Fourthwall shop.

fields.description: Fourthwall's id for this event. A retried delivery carries the same id.

The buyer's message. Empty when they left none.

The amount with two decimals and no currency symbol.
ISO 4217 code.
True when Fourthwall marks the event as test data.
How many items were in the order.
The products ordered, separated by commas.

triggers.name: Fourthwall gift purchase
triggers.description: Fires when someone buys items to be given away to your community.
triggers.sentence: Someone buys gifts for your community

triggers.name: Fourthwall membership purchased
triggers.description: Fires when someone joins your Fourthwall membership.
